text: 2026年中国资本市场学术年会在上海开幕，周小川吴清朱忠明出席 2026年中国资本市场学术年会今天（11月14日）在上海开幕。
text_en: 2026 China Capital Market Academic Annual Conference opens in Shanghai, with Zhou Xiaochuan, Wu Qing and Zhu Zhongming attending. The 2026 China Capital Market Academic Annual Conference opened today (November 14) in Shanghai.
